**Latest finding:**

- The luma path has almost nothing left to thread — The four-worker optimum does not survive the luma path, and it moves the wrong way: two workers, 6.52 ms/frame against a sequential 8.49 — 1.30x, where the colour path measured on the same machine in the same session gets 1.44x — and four workers is 7.88 ms, 21% worse than two. Declining the convert removes most of what the interleave was overlapping, so the reasoning that a 3x smaller buffer would admit more workers is backwards: there is less parallel work, not more room for it. INFERRED_WORKER_CAP was wrong on this path in the harmful direction and LUMA_WORKER_CAP = 2 replaces it.
